core_categories: Apparel and Fashion; Living and Household Goods; Beauty and Cosmetics; Food and Gourmet; Retail Services
specialty_focus: Hyundai Home Shopping is a major South Korean remote-retailing subsidiary of the Hyundai Department Store Group, operating TV broadcasting, data broadcasting, and online/mobile channels. It sells general consumer goods, featuring curated lifestyle content, premium private-label fashion, and interactive mobile commerce. It does not specialize in wearable medical devices.
